title: Regional evidence handoff playbook for artifact lifecycle & automated attestations
creator: Leah Chen
description:
Purpose: define a playbook and implementation plan for handing off regional artifacts (logs, snapshots, attestations) into an automated evidence pipeline that satisfies SOC 2 / ISO 27001 control assertions for data residency and retention.

Background: Customers require reproducible proof that Redwood enforces region-bound retention and residency controls and that artifacts used for audits are complete, tamper-evident, and time-bounded. Current work programs collect evidence in ad-hoc ways across teams (infra logs, console exports, s3 life-cycle snapshots). This ticket consolidates an operational playbook and the mapping required for automated collectors and attestation-generation so we can deliver consistent audit bundles per region and per customer tenancy.

Goals:
- Produce a documented playbook for the artifact lifecycle (collection, normalization, storage, retention, deletion, attestation).
- Define automated collectors for the minimal artifact set required to prove SOC 2 and ISO 27001 controls related to data residency (e.g., VPC placement, cloud storage region, dedicated capacity pinning) and retention schedules (S3 lifecycle, DB TTL, logs retention).
- Map evidence artifacts to control clauses and produce a template attestation manifest for auditors.
- Implement a small pilot that produces a region-scoped evidence bundle and automated attestation for one internal customer (sandbox account) for verification.

Scope (in):
- Evidence types: access logs, key management audit entries, object storage lifecycle snapshots, DB export manifests, console change events (rollouts), route/policy assignment records.
- Controls: SOC 2 CC6 (retention & disposal), SOC 2 CC7 (systems & communications), ISO 27001 A.8.3 (media handling), A.12 (operational procedures), plus our internal residency controls.

Scope (out):
- Full enterprise-wide archival of historical artifacts older than retention period (handled by separate archival project).
- Legal-subpoena workflows and eDiscovery (separate legal runbook).

Acceptance criteria:
- A written playbook stored in Drive describing artifact lifecycle steps and roles for collectors, normalizers, and attestors.
- A control-to-artifact mapping table (CSV) that ties each artifact to a control ID and minimum retention duration.
- One automated collector that captures object storage lifecycle snapshots per region and emits a signed manifest to the evidence store.
- Demo: generate an evidence bundle for sandbox-account-REGION-A, including manifest, collector logs, and an attestation PDF with signer, timestamp, and hash of bundle.
- Security review completed and documented (security_review_required flag true).
Implementation plan: Week 1: Align stakeholders and finalize artifact list (PM, Security, Infra, Runtime)
Week 2: Design collector spec + manifest schema (signed SHA256 hashes, signer identity, timestamp, region tag)
Week 3: Build collector for S3 lifecycle snapshot and KMS audit tailing (engineering prototype)
Week 4: Integrate collector output into evidence-store (immutable blob + index) and attach manifest
Week 5: Produce attestation generator (templated PDF + signature using Redwood KMS) and run pilot
Week 6: Review pilot outputs with Security and Compliance, iterate, and schedule wider rollout
collector_spec_summary: Collectors must be region-aware, produce stable artifact identifiers, include source metadata (region, project, retention-policy-id), and publish a signed manifest. Minimal collector outputs: artifact_id, artifact_type, start_time, end_time, region, storage_location, hash_sha256, collector_version. Collector must support idempotent replays and include sequence numbers for ordering.
manifests_and_attestations: Manifest format: newline-delimited JSON lines (NDJSON) where each line is a flattened artifact record. Attestation: PDF + metadata JSON containing attestation_id, signer, signature_sha256, signed_at, jurisdiction, control_mapping_refs. All outputs are immutable; store with write-once semantics in evidence-store bucket with retention policy matching longer of control or legal hold.
risk_and_mitigations: Collector failure/incomplete runs -> implement retries, dead-letter queue, and runbook for manual reconcile
Cross-region misattribution -> embed region tag and compare with infra routing tables during post-collection validation
Tamper risk -> sign manifests and store hashes in tamper-evident ledger (WIP)
metrics_and_success_signals: % of required artifacts collected per scheduled run >= 98%
Time from collection to attestation delivery <= 24 hours for pilot accounts
False-positive mismatches in control mapping < 1% during verification phase
rollout_strategy: Pilot with sandbox-account-REGION-A -> iterate on collector stability and manifest format -> expand pilot to 3 region-account pairs -> enable opt-in toggle in Console for customers to request region-scoped evidence bundles (beta) -> GA for enterprise customers with dedicated capacity.
dependencies_notes: Depends on ENG-76133 (local snapshot agent) for DB snapshot hooks; depends on PM-42177 for regional policy catalogue. Need a KMS approval board meeting to permit automated attestation signing for non-prod pilot.
deliverables: Pilot evidence bundle (hashed) and attestation PDF
